reason: I get three or four of these agency pitches every week, and the only proof here is one logistics client, not a wholesaler like me. I might take the free list of 15 companies to look at, but I would not start a pilot this month without my partner seeing results first.
objection: Who are you? One logistics case with 45 meetings tells me nothing about whether buyers in a new country will talk to a distributor, and I worry about agency emails going out under my company's name and hurting my reputation with the market.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies turns out to be companies I didn't already know and actually want, and I can call another wholesaler in Bulgaria who has used you, I would bring it to my partner.
